edits.value: Combinational from current q: ena[0] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9 (tens digit should increment); ena[1] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9 and q[7:4] == 9 (hundreds digit should increment); ena[2] = 1 iff q[3:0] == 9, q[7:4] == 9, and q[11:8] == 9 (thousands digit should increment). Treat ena as a 3-bit unsigned integer with ena[0] as LSB: ena = ((q & 15)==9 ? 1 : 0) + (((q & 255)==0x99) ? 2 : 0) + (((q & 4095)==0x999) ? 4 : 0).
